text: Assumption: The underlying storage resource is released as soon as the last referencing SharedHandle is destroyed — is this correct?

norm: the underlying storage resource is released as soon as the last referencing sharedhandle is destroyed
assumption: The underlying storage resource is released as soon as the last referencing SharedHandle is destroyed.
rationale: SharedHandle implements shared ownership of storage objects, but possesses no explicit close method in the payload.

original.text: Annahme: Die unterliegende Speicherressource wird vermutlich freigegeben, sobald das letzte referenzierende SharedHandle zerstört wird — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Die unterliegende Speicherressource wird vermutlich freigegeben, sobald das letzte referenzierende SharedHandle zerstört wird.
original.rationale: SharedHandle realisiert geteilten Besitz an Storage-Objekten, besitzt aber im Payload keine explizite Schließmethode.
